04/21/2025  /  BOSSPEC Administration Services Building first floor lobby tour with Yuma Navy League Council members  County Administration  Ian McGaughey 
The Board will be joined by members of the Yuma Navy League Council for a brief tour of the new building’s first-floor lobby area. The Navy League is considering a location for a possible donation. 

No Board action will be taken related to this agenda item.  View Agenda Item
05/19/2025  /  BOSREG Reappoint Emilia Cortez to the Library District Board of Trustees   Library District  Ashley Jones 
On April 16, 2025, the Yuma City Council voted to reappoint Emilia Cortez to the Free Library District Board of Trustees, to represent the City of Yuma for an additional three-year term. Ms. Cortez's current term ends on June 30, 2025. The Yuma County Board of Supervisors, sitting as the Yuma County Free Library District Board of Directors, is asked to confirm the appointment. 

This action is consistent with the bylaws of the Free Library District Board of Trustees.   View Agenda Item
12/15/2025  /  BOSREG Chairman appoints YCBOS members to Boards & Commissions for CY 2026  Clerk of Board Division   
Clerk of the Board: The Chairman will appoint Board members to serve on the following Boards and Commissions for Calendar Year 2026:
a) Chamber of Commerce Legislative Affairs Committee;
b) Chamber of Commerce Transportation Committee;
c) County Supervisors Association Legislative Policy Committee;
d) Greater Yuma Economic Development Corporation;
e) Local Emergency Planning Committee;
f) Local Workforce Development Board Liaison (AZ@Work - Yuma County);
g) Western Arizona Council of Governments Boards;
h) Yuma Agriculture Water Coalition, Inc.; and,
i) Yuma Crossing National Heritage Area Corporation.  View Agenda Item
